bounded_repairs_implemented.name: Atomic initialize_new Transaction & Fsync Durability
bounded_repairs_implemented.summary: Encompassed schema DDL and all 5 meta entries in a single BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... COMMIT transaction with explicit ROLLBACK on failure. Added post-commit fsync_dir with explicit commit_uncertain outcome on commit or fsync failure. Preserved exclusive 0700/0600 file creation with zero deletion of ambiguous DB files.

bounded_repairs_implemented.name: Versioned Injective Request Digest & Delimiter Protection
Strict JSON Schemas & Exact Field Whitelisting
bounded_repairs_implemented.summary: Enforced check_allowed_fields across all 5 commands and nested objects (read_set_assertions, changes, reservation_delta). Any unknown field (such as 'invented': true) is rejected with unknown_json_field. Canonical bot ID bounded to positive decimal 1 <= bot_id <= 9007199254740991. Strict 64-hex lowercase request digests. Version/hash invariants enforced. Duplicate readset keys rejected with duplicate_read_set_key; duplicate changes rejected with duplicate_change_key. Redacted error messages reflect no private canary tokens, keys, paths, or bodies.

bounded_repairs_implemented.name: Full Ancestor Path Confinement & Symlink Elimination
bounded_repairs_implemented.summary: Implemented check_ancestor_paths using Unix.lstat iteratively from '/' up to immediate parent directory. Rejects any symlink in ancestor chain with db_path_symlink. Requires trusted owner (UID 0 or current UID) and non-writable foreign ancestors, with dedicated 0700 immediate parent owned by current UID. /tmp sticky bit (0o1000) permitted as explicit exception.

bounded_repairs_implemented.name: Commit Uncertainty & Durable Operation Reconciliation
bounded_repairs_implemented.summary: Integrated controlled test hooks (test_hook_fail_*) for fault injection. Failures during COMMIT or post-commit return explicit commit_uncertain error code. Proved that lookup_operation reconciles committed receipts after uncertain returns, while uncommitted rollbacks leave state clean at prior generation.

bounded_repairs_implemented.name: Storage Capacity & Bounds Enforcement
bounded_repairs_implemented.summary: Preserved 20,000 rows capacity cap, 20,000 receipts capacity cap, 256 MiB main DB bound, delta limits (rows <= 20, receipts <= 64), busy_timeout = 250ms, journal_mode = WAL, synchronous = FULL, and foreign_keys = ON.
